title: Editor E0 task 14, nurture step designer runs on nodes behind render_path_email
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. updateStepBlockJson stores a node document through prepareEmailLayoutWrite (behind render_path_email; the switch off and legacy-over-nodes still return NODE_LAYOUT_WRITE_ERROR). The nurture page passes nodeLayout (stored nodes as they are, a legacy body upgraded in memory) only while the switch is on, and StepBlockEditor then mounts the node store and NodeEmailCanvasEditor with a node preview. The runner already parsed node documents (parseEmailRenderLayout). Switch off: no change. Next: the member side and task 15 backfill.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];if(!fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/marketing/nurture/actions.ts','utf8').includes('prepareEmailLayoutWrite'))bad.push('nurture save skips the shared write decision');if(!fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/marketing/nurture/page.tsx','utf8').includes(\"renderPathEnabled('email')\"))bad.push('step nodes not behind render_path_email');if(!fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/marketing/nurture/step-block-editor.tsx','utf8').includes('NodeEmailCanvasEditor'))bad.push('step editor has no node twin');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1061: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the nurture save bypasses the shared write decision, serves nodes without the switch, or loses the node step editor. Behavior is actions.node-safety.test.ts.
